name: framegate
description: Spec-driven, test-first workflow driven from the chat: /framegate:feature (spec dialogue, short briefs at every gate, background run with a live view, cleanup), /framegate:setup, /framegate:resume, /framegate:status, plus phase-lock (PreToolUse) and require-green (Stop) hooks that call the framegate CLI. Inactive in repos without framegate.toml.
